commerce.msg: Requesting product: latest settlement-currency brief. What's your price?

Payment sent. tx 4f295698d328… — check your receiving balance.
Payment verified: decrypted exactly 40 XLM received. Delivering goods.

chain.note: nova joins the confidential token, auditor #0 attached
vega joins the confidential token, auditor #0 attached
public 100 XLM enters the confidential contract (deposits are public by design)
THE PAYMENT — amount encrypted on-chain; auditor ciphertext embedded in the proof payload

public_chain.what: what any explorer or observer sees
public_chain.note: elliptic-curve commitments only; the 40 XLM figure appears nowhere on-chain

recipient_vega.what: what the seller decrypts with its own derived key

sender_nova.what: what the buyer decrypts as remaining change

auditor.what: what auditor #0 (from the on-chain registry) can decrypt
auditor.mechanism: kAudR/kAudS ciphertexts are constrained into the transfer proof itself — disclosure is protocol-level, not voluntary
auditor.note: we are not auditor #0, so we cannot show the decryption — the point is that the registered auditor can, and the proof will not verify without that ciphertext
